label: Tomato___Early_blight
symptoms: Dark concentric spots on older leaves, yellowing, defoliation.
organic_treatment: Neem oil spray, remove affected leaves, improve air circulation, Trichoderma soil application.
chemical_treatment: Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5g/L or Chlorothalonil, repeat at 10-day interval. Follow label safety.
prevention: Crop rotation, drip irrigation, mulching, balanced fertilization.

label: Tomato___Late_blight
symptoms: Water-soaked lesions on leaves and fruits, white mildew under humid conditions.
organic_treatment: Destroy infected plants, copper oxychloride (allowed in organic in limited dose), garlic extract.
chemical_treatment: Metalaxyl + Mancozeb combo @ 2.5g/L immediately. Urgent action needed.
prevention: Avoid overhead irrigation, resistant varieties, forecast-based spraying.

label: Potato___Healthy
organic_treatment: No treatment needed. Continue good practices.
prevention: Regular scouting, balanced nutrition, clean seed tubers.

label: Maize___Common_rust
symptoms: Reddish-brown pustules on leaves, reduces photosynthesis.
organic_treatment: Sulphur dust, resistant hybrids next season.
prevention: Early sowing, weed control, avoid dense planting.

label: Rice___Bacterial_leaf_blight
symptoms: Yellowing and drying of leaves from tip, wilting in severe cases.
organic_treatment: Pseudomonas fluorescens seed treatment, drain field briefly.
chemical_treatment: Streptocycline + Copper oxychloride spray. Consult agri officer.
prevention: Resistant varieties, balanced nitrogen, field sanitation.

label: Cotton___Healthy
prevention: Pheromone traps for bollworm, regular scouting.
